newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen continuing rally.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to continue their rally on active buying on Tuesday, despite Monday's cyclone in the south of the country, brokers said.

"The market is likely to remain firm," said broker Khurshid Alam. He added investors would probably ignore the feared impact of Monday's cyclone, which newspapers said had killed up to 500 people and caused widespread damage.
But Redwanul Islam of Dastagir Mohammad Adil and Company said food shares could be affected as shrimp farms along the coast were badly hit by the cyclone.
"Any major damage in the industrial belt in Chittagong will unnerve the market. The washing away of shrimp beds will affect food scrips," Islam said
Brokers said engineering, pharmaceutical and leather scrips with strong economic fundamentals might draw attention.
The DSE's benchmark index rose 47.50 points or 3.99 percent to 1,236.96 ppoints on tunrover of 96.7 million taka on Monday.
